primitives.name: Dieline Integrity Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Preserve dieline folds, cut lines, bleed, and safe zones.
primitives.assumptions: Dieline geometry is fixed and non-deformable under standard manufacturing tolerances.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When D, C, B, S deviate beyond ±0.5mm from specification.

layer2.mapping: Dieline structure maps to geometric constraints in GSE's state transition graph; each fold/cut corresponds to a discrete transformation.
layer2.telemetry: Verification of fold alignment and cut accuracy via CAD inspection

primitives.name: Variant Consistency Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Use one system across variants; vary only approved product information and designated color roles.
primitives.assumptions: All variants share identical layout templates and font systems.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When P or R diverges from approved set of values.

layer2.mapping: Each variant is a projection of a base template under a controlled parameter space; GSE enforces this through state vector normalization.
layer2.telemetry: Cross-variant visual consistency score derived from normalized color and layout metrics

primitives.name: Slot Allocation Function
primitives.verbatim_quote: # Packaging Design packaging once the slots used by the requested artwork are approved.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'S_a': 'allocated slot area (square millimeters)', 'S_u': 'unused slot area (square millimeters)', 'A': 'artwork area (square millimeters)'}
primitives.assumptions: Artwork fits within pre-approved slot boundaries without overlap.

layer2.mapping: Slot allocation mirrors GSI’s probabilistic slot assignment in packaging workflows; each slot maps to an independent variable in a Bayesian model.
layer2.telemetry: Slot utilization efficiency measured as ratio of A/S_a
